issue_context.title: Scheduler: skip updates of assumed pods
issue_context.body:
#### What would you like to be added:

Currently the scheduler may add an assumed pod back to the queue if the update didn't include specific fields (see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/58814dbe3fc13602fb8a9ac67f9e046c9eb09326/pkg/scheduler/eventhandlers.go#L307).

There doesn't seem to be a reason why we can't simply ignore all updates of assumed pods. Assumed pods are waiting to be bound, if binding succeeded then the pod is scheduled. If binding fails, the pod's latest version will be put back into the unschedulable queue anyways.

#### Why is this needed:

Performance: we save on unnecessary scheduling attempts.

This is a followup on the discussion we had in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/98828

/sig scheduling
/triage accepted
/help

1) remove `skipPodUpdate` function
2) in the places where we call `skipPodUpdate`, we should simply call `cache.IsAssumedPod(pod)`
